title: Evidence credit optimizer for contract uptake pilot
creator: Priya Desai
description:
Summary: Pilot an automated evidence-crediting flow that reduces friction in enterprise security questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ) cycles by combining curated answer templates, auto-assembled evidence bundles, and a tiered credit applied to customer invoices or onboarding credits. Goal is to accelerate contract closure and reduce manual effort for both customers and Redwood SEs while tracking unit economics of evidence production.

Hypothesis: Offering a measurable, time-limited evidence credit (redeemable as support hours or onboarding credits) together with auto-curated CAIQ/SIG answer bundles will increase enterprise conversion rate and reduce average time-to-sign by at least 10% for pilot accounts. We expect the largest win in mid-market accounts where security questionnaires create measurable sales friction.

Scope: Pilot will include: 1) UI in Console for requesting an 'Evidence Pack + Credit' during sales negotiation; 2) Server-side automated evidence assembler that maps our canonical answers to customer questionnaire artifacts (SIG, CAIQ) and bundles linked artifacts (KMS docs, SOC snapshots); 3) Pricing/crediting rules engine to apply tiered credits (Lite/Standard/Full) to invoices or onboarding credits; 4) Telemetry and dashboard for measuring time-saved, conversion lift, and cost of producing evidence.

Out of scope for pilot: full contract automation, verifiable signed attestations via HSM/KMS (future), and marketplace of re-usable answer modules.

Signals / Metrics: Primary: enterprise conversion rate for pilot cohort (target +10% relative lift), median time from RFP to contract signature (target -10%), average manual hours saved for SE/customer (target -60%). Secondary: number of evidence packs requested, cost per evidence pack generated, net revenue impact after crediting.

Experiment design: Randomized pilot group of 30 progressive deals (10 high-touch enterprise, 20 mid-market) offered an evidence pack + credit at negotiation stage; control group proceeds with standard SE support. Track outcomes over 90 days. Credit tiers: Lite (equiv. 4h) / Standard (12h) / Full (30h equivalent). Credits capped per account. Use unique campaign tag for telemetry.

Rollout plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks) - implement Console request flow and basic pack generator with manual review by Security SME. Phase 2 (4 weeks) - automation improvements: mapping templates, artifact linking, auto-attach to Drive/Confluence, billing integration. Phase 3 - run 90-day pilot, collect metrics and interviews, prepare PRD for scale.

Implementation notes: Backend endpoints: POST /enterprise/evidence-request, GET /evidence-pack/{id}; storage policy: evidence bundles stored in customer-shared, read-only Drive/Confluence links with ACLs; logs scrubbed of customer-sensitive data. Billing integration: create 'evidence_credit' line-item and a negative invoice adjustment for pilot deals.

Stakeholders: PM (Priya), Eng lead (Mateo), Security SME (Elena Novak), Legal (Omar Hassan), Sales lead (Lucas Green), Solutions Engs pilot squad.

Acceptance criteria: 1) Console flow implemented and QAed; 2) Evidence pack generator produces correct CAIQ mappings for 90% of common controls without manual edits; 3) Billing integration applies credits correctly and appears on invoice; 4) Pilot metrics dashboard populated and reportsable at end of pilot.

Risks and mitigations: Over-crediting (cap credits and manual approval for Full tier), leaking sensitive excerpts (ACLs + manual review + security review), inflated conversion signal due to selection bias (randomized assignment), accounting complexity (work with finance to reconcile credits).

Privacy/security: Security review required. Evidence artifacts may contain configuration detail; we will scrub secrets and provide guidance to SEs for redaction. KMS/HSM signing explicitly excluded from pilot.

Success criteria & next steps: If primary metrics met, prepare full rollout with tighter automation and add signed attestations as paid add-on. If conversion lift is low but time-savings high, consider expanding to a per-request paid evidence pack with lower credits.
